name: edgeglint
description: First-party web analytics for Cloudflare Workers and Analytics Engine, without measurement cookies or visitor identifiers.

DASH_KEY.description: Generate a private key with `openssl rand -hex 32`. Set it as a runtime secret, not a build secret.

SITES.description: Your site host names, separated by commas. Example: `example.com`.

ROUTES.description: Public page paths to measure. Example: `/,/pricing,/blog/*`.

COLLECT.description: Keep `off` until you configure hosts, paths and bindings. Set `on` to collect.

TELEMETRY.description: Writes to the `edgeglint` Analytics Engine dataset. Enable Analytics Engine in the account dashboard first.

ANALYTICS_SQL.description: Reads Analytics Engine through the SQL binding. Requires Wrangler 4.145.0 or later.

LIMITER.description: Limits requests per client IP at each Cloudflare location. Use an account-unique integer namespace ID.

PROBE_LIMITER.description: Limits token health queries at each Cloudflare location. Use a different account-unique integer namespace ID.
